photos.c: Back Cover: Jim Evans took up athletics only at the beginning of this season and was introduced to Belgrave by John Bicourt. Expecting to gradually get fit and have a real go next year, he was immediately thrown in at the deep end with a 100m run in our first league match in May and has regularly been a member of our teams ever since.
